repeat_holdout_warning: The frozen 240-case holdout had previously been inspected before this additional H2/H6 analysis; not a fresh independent blind test.

h2.interpretation: A Jev filter skipped only 10 optional audits and missed five seeded critical faults, while increasing model costs; not recommended for this optional-audit design.

cost_basis: Published list-price Oct 2026: Jev $0.042/million input; GPT-4o mini $0.15/million input and $0.60/million output. Derived from recorded provider tokens, not invoices. Excludes human review, infrastructure and end-to-end processing.
scope: Only optional trace QA, not insurance coverage, mandatory checks, automatic payment or customer-facing action.
limitations: Previously inspected holdout means this is exploratory posthoc analysis, not new independent holdout.
Risk scores and seeds refer to planted artificial trace faults, not production insurer outcomes.
The GPТ judge was not selectively invoked in real time; call skipping is counterfactual on recorded API answers.
Scores were not independently calibrated; dev set contains only 11 positives.
No human review costs or work minutes were measured.
